page_title: VER 1-2 PAR | Verona v Parma 23/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Parma fail to score from a corner as Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) leaps to collect the ball.

90' Oliver Sorensen (Parma) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Lorenzo Montipo easily deals with the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Parma will take a corner.
89' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Martin Frese (Verona) was quite harsh and Luca Pairetto didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
88' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Armel Bella-Kotchap will be replaced by Abdou Harroui (Verona).
85' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Adrian Bernabe Garcia.
84' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
80' 1 - 2 What a finish that is! Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) sees that Lorenzo Montipo is off his line and scores with a brilliant lob from the edge of the box. He makes it 1:2.
79' Great teamplay by Verona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
78' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) is penalised for a foul. Luca Pairetto had a clear view and blows his whistle.
77' Here is a change. Patrick Cutrone is going off and Carlos Cuesta gives the last tactical orders to Adrian Benedyczak (Parma).
77' The substitution has been made. Emanuele Valeri (Parma) has replaced Sascha Britschgi.
76' A corner kick by Verona is thwarted by the well prepared Edoardo Corvi (Parma).
76' Rafik Belghali (Verona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Verona force a corner. They send men into the box.
76' Verona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
70' Yellow card. Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
69' Martin Frese (Verona) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall.
68' Mandela Keita (Parma) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Verona win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
65' 1 - 1 The ball finds its way to Giovane (Verona) after a confusing situation inside the goalmouth. He finds some space and easily knocks the ball in with his body and alters the score to 1:1.
64' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Gift Orban is replaced by Amin Sarr (Verona).
64' The game has come to an end for Victor Nelsson. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Unai Nunez (Verona).
63' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
62' Al Musrati (Verona) commits a rough foul. Luca Pairetto stops the game and makes a call. Parma are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
60' Verona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

58' Giovane (Verona) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Edoardo Corvi!
58' Martin Frese (Verona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
56' A cross from a corner kick by Parma is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
56' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Parma.
55' Al Musrati (Verona) has tested the patience of referee Luca Pairetto and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
54' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Daniel Mosquera (Verona) will replace Antoine Bernede.
53' Verona concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player.
51' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the right post, but Lorenzo Montipo is alert and denies him.

50' Mandela Keita (Parma) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed towards the bottom right corner, but Lorenzo Montipo reads it well and makes a comfortable save.

49' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of Oliver Sorensen (Parma) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
48' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
47' Luca Pairetto blows for a foul after Antoine Bernede (Verona) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Free kick. Parma will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
47' A pass from Gift Orban (Verona) is intercepted by Edoardo Corvi and the move breaks down.
46' Paolo Zanetti has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Al Musrati (Verona) comes on the pitch for Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The end of the first half.

45+3' The game is interrupted. Antoine Bernede (Verona) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. It's a free kick to Parma, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
45+2' The game is pretty dull as Parma are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
45+2' Gift Orban (Verona) commits a rough challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul. Parma are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
45' Mathias Lovik (Parma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
42' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Giovane (Verona) for his blatant foul.
39' Yellow card. Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
39' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Edoardo Corvi, who smothers the ball.
38' The foul by Gift Orban (Verona) was seen by Luca Pairetto who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Parma are awarded the free kick.
36' Parma fail to score from a corner as Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) leaps to collect the ball.
33' The ball is cleared after Oliver Sorensen (Parma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Parma force their opponents to concede a corner.
33' Rough tackle by Antoine Bernede (Verona). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Parma will take a free kick.
31' Luca Pairetto has a clear sight and sees a foul from Martin Frese (Verona). Parma have a free kick from a promising distance.

30' It looked like the long-range shot by Antoine Bernede (Verona) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
30' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Lautaro Valenti (Parma).
28' Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Parma.
28' Giovane (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
27' Mandela Keita (Parma) makes a strong challenge and Luca Pairetto blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Verona.
25' Giovane (Verona) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
24' Giovane (Verona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' Gift Orban (Verona) is flagged for offside.
22' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Verona.
20' OFF THE BAR! Oliver Sorensen (Parma) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
18' 0 - 1 Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is first to latch onto the rebound near the penalty spot, and he produces a fantastic header into the roof of the net.

16' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Parma win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
15' Rafik Belghali (Verona) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Parma.
14' The Parma players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

12' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Gift Orban (Verona), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
9' The goal by Verona won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
9' Wait! Referee Luca Pairetto has indicated he is going to review the Verona goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
9' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
8' Goal - 0:0! Domagoj Bradaric laid the ball off to Gift Orban (Verona), who shot from close range low into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
6' Parma control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
6' Giovane (Verona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Verona will take a throw-in.
3' Parma enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
2' Gift Orban (Verona) reacted quickly inside the box and got on the end of the resulting corner. He hit a low drive towards the middle, but the goalkeeper pulled off a great reflex save.
2' The corner is swung in but Verona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
2' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Verona.

1' Gift Orban (Verona) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play and Verona manage to earn a corner.
1' The first half has started.
Verona will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Luca Pairetto.
